notes.title: World Zero: The Red Update
notes.notes:
A mini update dedicated solely to Red! Red has been the least amount equippable items since the first build of the game and her only armour was accidentally given to Shouta instead. Not only that but her high guaranteed damage essentially trivializes the game.
So this mini update aims to fix all that with all new updates and balance changes!

Character Balancing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43012190/32053f0ee48d9a0b82b551acac7a080747ba4bea.png
What's New?
New armours have been added for Red
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43012190/81cccdd3864250833f3159b3a355f7fe091030ff.png

But that's not all!
The open Beta has also received an update! Fast travel will now be available in beta!(Technically it's in both builds just inaccessible to the main game)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43012190/5d219459c671daf25181ab0ae6f4c923aade8e1d.png


How to opt into beta:
1. Right click on the application itself on the steam library and go to "Properties".
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43012190/a69f801c186118d0dee1f2fff880c414185f88c5.png

2. Next, go to the "Betas" tab
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43012190/32ec58ba276bf0a549b7b3adcee24ea4a63befdf.png

3. Now pick the option "openbeta"
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43012190/5c8a4091f97cdb1b905dd61a778739aab5d9cc23.png

4. The game should now update to allow access to the World Zero: Blood and Steel beta!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43012190/9103914997a4f6359b21bde69e725190efe9f82a.png

Feed back would be greatly appreciated:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf3PqYo6_cHzxIE0bq6g6oEmyqEGulifsfbEBg9-98NsnJqoQ/viewform?usp=header

The first ever major Update for World Zero is here! This update was made to polish some stuff out like gameplay and dialogue to prepare the game for future updates.

Character Balancing
Several characters in the game felt either too weak or too strong and sometimes, somehow, both.
These are the list of changes for each character in this update.
